name: Norisring
notes: Street circuit used unchanged since 1972 (counter-clockwise): start/finish on Beuthener Strasse by the Steintribuene, Grundig-Kehre at the SE end, back on the other carriageway, Schoeller-S onto Zeppelinstrasse, Dutzendteich-Kehre at the NW end. Routed over the members of OSM circuit relation 1889538 (pit lane excluded).
